nieuw.titel: Use Lumbering to finish perpendicular with several charge options
nieuw.tekst: Use Lumbering pivots and planned wheels to finish perpendicular to the opposing force, outside its charge arcs, with the widest possible choice of legal charges next turn. Reserve Move makes this positioning easier; pre-measure the movement needed to wheel back before using the final pivot.
nieuw.waarom: He considers chariots poor when they cannot get the charge. He says Lumbering is often on powerful hammer units with Close Order, whose charge arcs need careful positioning.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He moved his Black Coach 11 inches forward and pivoted 45 degrees away from the enemy. During its Reserve Move, he moved eight inches forward, used two inches to wheel back, then pivoted 90 degrees towards the enemy, finishing perpendicular and outside their charge arc.

bronnen.citaat: you need to make sure that you have that maximizing your charge arc.

nieuw.titel: Use the Black Coach's mobility to attack vulnerable backline targets
nieuw.tekst: Use the Black Coach's Ethereal flying option, combined with Reserve Move when available, to get behind the enemy army and attack vulnerable targets such as war machine crews.
nieuw.waarom: He finds the combination of Ethereal, toughness six and a three-plus armour save highly resilient, while its mobility gets it across the board quickly.

nieuw.titel: Keep a BSB nearby to support restraint and reform
nieuw.tekst: Keep a battle standard bearer nearby when you want a victorious unit to restrain and reform instead of continuing into an unwanted fight.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His nearby battle standard bearer supplied a leadership reroll that let the Black Coach restrain and reform after beating a Razorgor. Instead of continuing into what he considered a suicidal fight, it flew over the enemy and helped secure unit strength in a back quarter for Domination.
